newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-STATE PUTS 51 PCT OF EMEX UP FOR SALE.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-STATE PUTS 51 PCT OF EMEX UP FOR SALE.

text.p: Estonia's Privatisation Agency said on Wednesday it was starting the process to sell 51 percent of the state's holding in the Estonian Metal Export Co (EMEX).
Agency spokeswoman Joole Kuljus said full details of the sale will be released on Thursday.
The closing date for bidding will be May 8.
This is the second time the agency has sold part of EMEX.
The state sold a five percent slice of EMEX last November/December which removed 63 million kroons worth of vouchers from circulation.

Vouchers were given to Estonian citizens after the country regained independence in 1991 to compensate for property that was expropriated during the Soviet era and for years worked during this period.
Kuljus said the 51 percent sale would be open to overseas investors as well as Estonian investors, taking both cash and vouchers. The bid price must be quoted in kroons.
